summary: 87 features and 18 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • sessions: open validated chat paths on the host (74206a1)
  • config: persist conversation path opening mode (994cfd4)
  • skills: install gallery skills into registered bases (31093a9)
  • sessions: resolve Hero names in session creation requests (bb2c79e)
  • saga-preset: explain parallel groups during plan review (4f95c52)
  • images: stream session-local images through a guarded endpoint (dfc35fc)
  • token-monitor: expose time-of-day usage rates (5638bf1)
  • scheduled-plans: skip confirmation during unattended hours (732407f)
  • saga: expose bounded reads for Saga key files (32856c6)
  • saga: add a typed RPC for reading Saga key files (a6cc730)
  • sessions: add write-once user metadata to sessions (c89ba23)
  • saga-preset: read CLI methods and detect prompt drift (9279462)
  • sessions: filter session listings by user metadata (4e0d339)
  • saga-preset: let agents select Saga IDs in conversation (7d7605d)
  • saga: expose bounded read-only project overviews (1ee0529)
  • copilot-fusion: propagate request tiers through sessions (d77a1cf)
  • saga: expose project summaries and ship workflow preset (5bd5f6d)
  • coordination: add persistent cross-agent resource locks (798043b)
  • sessions: store creator-supplied user metadata (4fe1061)
  • tokenmonitor: raise warning, exhausted and reset alerts (de91abb)
  • notifications: read saved token usage alert switches (8433da7)
  • signalr: broadcast token usage alert transitions (d3e6ac4)
  • frontend-config: add token usage alert rules (2acc2d8)

HagiCode-org/web

  • themes: audit and normalize theme color usage (88b5106)
  • turbo-engine: add dedicated promotion artwork (febcb26)
  • skills: choose skill gallery installation targets (823b24b)
  • paths: add configurable local path opening modes (9e52f45)
  • projects: show project icons in selection controls (94cb344)
  • mobile: improve task and proposal creation choices (00e06b4)
  • skills: organize skills into library and source tabs (00e30fe)
  • mobile: add a server entry screen for typed addresses (eb1ca87)
  • lib: resolve and probe manually entered server addresses (bcd515c)
  • token-monitor: add a pace ring to the usage mark (fe8fc9f)
  • conversation: add local image footnotes and previews (d4fe684)
  • saga: add a dedicated info tab to Saga sessions (07a3593)
  • token-monitor: add time-of-day usage rate RPC types (e0c913a)
  • scheduled-plans: add unattended-hour confirmation (f5e07d0)
  • token-monitor: add time-of-day rate comparisons (fc84ff4)
  • i18n: add mobile feature labels for all locales (5ae380a)
  • mobile-history: load visible messages in older-page batches (707339f)
  • mobile-usage: animate changing token readings (91f154c)
  • mobile-input: arrange remote commands as a compact pad (379cbe6)
  • mobile-session-list: add swipe actions to session rows (23370f1)
  • mobile: improve session and creation workflows (0c14852)
  • saga: add shared recognition and key-file reads (6d3746c)
  • saga: add conversation and key-file tabs to Saga sessions (aec958e)
  • saga: poll key files for active conversation tabs (5b0d2fb)
  • saga: recognize masters and read key Saga files (de8dc57)
  • kanban-matrix: keep the session column beside the grid (7064db2)
  • token-monitor: share quota reset pending labels (eeea06f)
  • proposal: share stage rail rules across clients (91eac14)
  • sessions: group Saga orchestrators with their Workers (ed0f355)
  • mobile: streamline session creation forms and task inputs (0a39030)
  • web: add interactive tiles to Saga worker group drawer (c3d2edb)
  • web: show Saga Worker stacks in Kanban matrix (de0e9c9)
  • web: align Saga worker cards with session cards (76ef3ec)
  • mobile: align Saga group rows with session rows (79903fd)
  • web: group Saga workers across session views (1758a45)
  • mobile: group Saga workers in the session list (799eac9)
  • lib: add shared Saga worker grouping and lookup helpers (8a8a13d)
  • web: add read-only Saga overviews to the project panel and header (6a92a4c)
  • web: show Saga runtime summaries in conversations (792a291)
  • web: add Copilot Fusion model and tier controls (f1b2a1f)
  • mobile: show Steer as an icon in session detail (dfbfe04)
  • mobile: pair Send and Steer in the Remote input screen (b9fdcce)
  • web: offer Steer as a remote command beside Send (81db407)
  • mobile: turn the running mark and sweep running rows (edf181c)
  • mobile: reopen the Sessions list in the last view (6f3aaf4)
  • mobile: draw nested lists, strikethrough and image text (985b658)
  • mobile: list recent repositories first in HagiTask pickers (47ba14e)
  • mobile: add a Remote input screen for the desktop (7e1c529)
  • i18n: add mobile strings for remote input and proposal files (fa3037b)
  • lib: parse nested lists, strikethrough, images and bare URLs (8ea9ab1)
  • lib: add remote input commands and Hagi Input persistence (d316f75)
  • mobile: cycle session views from a header button (66650eb)
  • mobile: list a created proposal instead of opening it (acbe94f)
  • mobile: send token usage alerts as system notifications (0cf98a7)
  • mobile: show the proposal task ring and status marks (35daa88)
  • mobile: draw repository icons and recent repositories (63233ee)
  • mobile: keep send, stop and review busy until settled (a95e68c)
  • mobile: add press feedback and busy state to controls (80da756)
  • i18n: add mobile strings for alerts and pickers (853095a)
  • web: notify token usage warnings, exhaustion and resets (68781ad)
  • web: list new sessions without opening them (728ce26)
  • lib: stream token usage alerts and task progress live (9ea265f)
  • lib: add proposal task progress and the Needs You rule (f4b1cc5)
  • lib: share repository icon rules and configured icons (566da2c)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • sessions: preserve metadata during concurrent updates (78a874e)
  • sessions: prioritize regular sessions over Saga Workers (cc4bb33)
  • copilot-fusion: reject incompatible requests before queueing (d0adf0a)
  • signalr: write userMetadata on session wire frames (73146db)

HagiCode-org/web

  • themes: preserve themed surfaces in achievement and slider controls (b1acd41)
  • mentions: close the picker before host drawers (0211962)
  • kanban: acknowledge matrix clicks in the session column (84c223f)
  • kanban: keep selected matrix cells open on repeat clicks (ac04769)
  • layout: size session grids from their containers (bf0ea19)
  • saga: keep active-tab updates with the Saga session panel (c2c27cf)
  • project-list: remove the project title tooltip (caf5ffa)
  • web: close the session drawer after generation completes (3bf72ee)
  • web: clear Copilot Fusion tier for single-model saves (7216bce)
  • mobile: keep a folded tool group’s pictures visible (8ba1b70)
  • mobile: stop horizontal tables from claiming spare height (d4be2fe)
  • web: keep the planning direction switch out of a button (61c749f)
  • web: stop body drags from closing the session drawer (6441e43)
  • mobile: pin the session detail to the newest message (b312e2a)
